basic_info.description: Rarely Available Condo at The Grove! Nestled in a serene, forest-like setting just steps away from Stern Grove, this spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo offers 1,745 square feet of comfortable living space. The unit features a master suite, a generous living room with an electric fireplace, a formal dining room, and a huge private balcony. The building boasts 24-hour security, an elevator, and 1-car parking in a garage. Conveniently located near Stern Grove, Stonestown Galleria, City Sport, YMCA, West Portal, Taraval St., restaurants, shops, Lakeshore Plaza, and public transportation. You'll also be close to top-rated Lowell High School, West Portal Lutheran Church & School, SFSU, and major freeways. Don't miss out on this exceptional opportunity for one of the largest 3BD/2BA unit in the complex! Must-See!
